resources.string:
Your widgets show what the Tracker writes to the "Widget" tab of your Sophmore Year sheet, and send what you tap or type back to the Tracker through the sheet's phone script.

One-time setup:
1. Paste your phone link below (Claude gave it to you; it ends in /exec?k=…) and tap Save and test.
2. Long-press your home screen → Widgets → Tracker Widgets, and add the ones you want: Health, Money, Today, School and Inbox.

Anything you add from a widget shows right away with ⏳ and goes into the Tracker the next time the Tracker is open (on your phone or laptop). Tap a widget's empty space to open the Tracker, or ↻ to refresh it.

When this is on, the sender\'s name and the text of each incoming message notification from your texting app go to the \"Phone Queue\" tab of your sheet, and the Tracker\'s Inbox asks Claude whether there\'s something to add (a plan, money owed, a deadline). Messages you send and sign-in codes are skipped. Turn it off any time.
